answer.title: Automate Booking Rescheduling from Helpdesk
answer.trigger: A helpdesk ticket is received requesting to move an existing booking.
steps: Read the incoming helpdesk ticket to identify the customer and requested new date.
Extract the current booking details from the jobs system.
Draft the booking reschedule update in the jobs system.
Wait for staff approval to apply the schedule change.
answer.ai_help: Extract the customer name, current booking reference, and requested new date and time from the helpdesk ticket text.
answer.human_approval: Claire must review and approve the updated booking time in the jobs system before it is saved.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation picks the wrong date or time, the customer could miss their appointment or the business could double-book.
